newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Fiba Nordic denies London closure report.
newsitem.headline: Fiba Nordic denies London closure report.

text.p: Norwegian brokerage Fiba Nordic securities denied on Tuesday Swedish media reports that it was dismantling its London operation, but said it would scale down its corporate finance operation in the British capital.

"We're not closing down, we're scaling down the corporate finance operation as a result of the negative publicity surrounding the Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) share fund affair," Peter Karlsson, Managing Director of Fiba's Swedish operation told Reuters.
The corporate finance operation accounted for five of 45 employees at the London office, he added.
Business daily Dagens Industri (DI) said on Tuesday that Erik Langaker, one of Fiba Nordic's founders and chief dealers, had agreed with the board to leave the company in the wake of the DMG affair.
"At the same time, Fiba's London office is being dismantled," DI said.
It said Fiba Nordic was conducting an internal investigation into the relationship between Fiba and Morgan Grenfell's funds.
"Erik Langaker has been responsible to a large degree for the deals done which have been discussed in the press," Karlsson told the newspaper.
Three of DMG's share funds are under investigation by British and Nordic finance watchdogs following irregular dealings by former fund manager Peter Young.
